# Inter (Latin subset)

[Inter](https://github.com/rsms/inter) Regular 4.1, subset to U+0020–U+007E.

- **File:** `Inter-Latin.ttf`
- **License:** SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`)

Used by `packages/glim-paint` as the v1 Latin face for SDF glyph runs. Not Apple San Francisco (proprietary; not redistributable).
